soundness_flags.label: thm:confidence-si-pag; ass:uniform-queried-stratum-mass; def:confidence-si-pag
soundness_flags.one_line: The pooled stratum floor does not lower-bound the conditioning-stratum mass in an arm-CI query's sampled law P_eta^(j): P_pool(W=w) can be positive while P_eta^(j)(W=w)=0, leaving that conditional table undefined and invalidating the displayed uniform sample bound.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:confidence-si-pag
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Its endpoint-coverage conclusion uses deterministic completeness of thm:complete-local-calculus, whose selection-lifting step remains the central open solve target.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-sample SI-PAG coverage conditional on a proved complete deterministic closure and on corrected armwise query-stratum positivity.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Lemma 4 characterizes intervention-created adjacencies; Lemma 5 gives indicator adjacency as direct targeting or indirect effect plus ancestral selection; Theorem 2 uses per-regime adjacencies and v-structures; §4 assumes causal sufficiency and faithfulness and states CDIS completeness remains uncertain.
The paper proves a sound-and-complete unknown-target soft-intervention learner, but its setup explicitly assumes no selection bias.

The paper gives polynomial-delay MAG listing by recursively enumerating singleton background knowledge and applying sound locally complete rules; it does not provide a common-basal selected-intervention calculus.
